title: Optimized Gutzwiller Projected States for Doped Antiferromagnets in Fermi-Hubbard Simulators
title_zh: 费米-哈伯德模拟器中掺杂反铁磁体的优化Gutzwiller投影态
summary: 本文利用机器学习方法，通过与实验数据比较来优化共振价键（RVB）态的平均场参数，从而确定一种具有物理动机且完全可解释的简单模型。所得RVB态能够同时描述实验测得的二点和三点关联，即使这些关联并未被专门用于优化。对平均场参数及其掺杂依赖性的分析，为可能存在的量子自旋液体态提供了物理认识。结果表明，费米-哈伯德量子模拟器的有限温度数据可以由RVB态较好地描述。
abstract: arXiv:2506.11227v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum many-body physics, one aims to understand emergent phenomena and effects of strong interactions, ideally by developing a simple theoretical picture. Recently, progress in quantum simulators has enabled the measurement of site resolved snapshots of Fermi-Hubbard systems at finite doping on square as well as triangular lattice geometries. These experimental advances pose the quest for theorists to analyze the ensuing data in order to gain insights into these prototypical, strongly correlated many-body systems. Here we employ machine learning techniques to optimize the mean-field parameters of a resonating valence bond (RVB) state through comparison with experimental data, thus determining a possible underlying simple model that is physically motivated and fully interpretable. We find that the resulting RVB states are capable of capturing two- as well as three-point correlations measured in experiments, even when they are not specifically used in the optimization. The analysis of the mean-field parameters and their doping dependence can be used to obtain physical insights and shed light on the nature of possible underlying quantum spin liquid states. Our results show that finite temperature data from Fermi-Hubbard quantum simulators can be well captured by RVB states. This work paves the way for a new, systematic analysis of data from numerical as well as quantum simulation of strongly correlated quantum many-body systems.

## 第一部分：核心概览 (Overview)
围绕冷原子费米-Hubbard量子模拟器中的掺杂反铁磁数据，构建并优化**Gutzwiller 投影有限温度 RVB/SFN 变分态**，用实验或数值关联函数反推最合适的平均场参数。核心贡献在于把**可解释的物理 ansatz**、**梯度下降优化**与**站点分辨关联测量**结合起来，证明简单的投影 RVB 态能同时拟合方格与三角晶格中的二点、三点关联，并从**通量 ϕ、有效温度 T_MF/J_MF、Néel 场 h/J_MF**的掺杂依赖中提取物理图景；不足之处主要在长程关联、较强粒子掺杂以及部分符号翻转上仍有偏差。

## 第二部分：结构化快速回顾
### 《Optimized Gutzwiller Projected States for Doped Antiferromagnets in Fermi-Hubbard Simulators》（None，）
- **背景**：掺杂 **Fermi-Hubbard 模型**长期难解，量子气体显微镜已能给出**站点分辨快照**和**有限掺杂**关联数据，迫切需要可解释理论模型。
- **方法**：构造有限温度 **Gutzwiller projected RVB/SFN** 态，通过比较实验关联函数并用**梯度下降**优化 **ϕ、T_MF/J_MF、h/J_MF**。
- **结果**：在方格与三角晶格上，模型能较好重现实验的**两点/三点关联**；对方格晶格的**dopant-dopant**相关也能捕捉主要趋势。
- **讨论**：优化后的参数随掺杂变化，揭示了**高掺杂趋向自由费米子图景**、**低掺杂更接近 Heisenberg/RVB** 的跨越。
- **局限**：**Gutzwiller 投影**排除了双占据相关；长程关联、某些符号变化、三角晶格大粒子掺杂区拟合较差。
- **结论**：有限温度实验数据可由**RVB**态有效描述，为后续强关联量子模拟数据的系统反演分析提供了可执行框架。

## 第三部分：逐章节冷凝解析 (Section-by-Section Condensing)

### Abstract
**核心命题：用可解释的 RVB 态拟合实验关联函数**  
有限温度冷原子数据成为检验强关联理论的对象；这里直接用机器学习优化 **RVB mean-field parameters**，得到“可能的底层简单模型”。原文关键表述为 *"we employ machine learning techniques to optimize the mean-field parameters"* 与 *"fully interpretable"*。目标不是黑箱分类，而是通过 **ϕ、T_MF/J_MF、h/J_MF** 解释实验中观测到的**二点与三点关联**。

**跨可观测量泛化：未参与优化的关联也能被捕捉**  
优化只针对部分相关函数，但结果仍能描述更高阶结构：*"capable of capturing two- as well as three-point correlations measured in experiments, even when they are not specifically used in the optimization"*。这说明 ansatz 不只是局部拟合，而是学到了相关结构的低维表征。

**物理外延：从数据反推自旋液体线索**  
平均场参数的掺杂依赖提供关于**quantum spin liquid** 的线索，原文强调 *"shed light on the nature of possible underlying quantum spin liquid states"*。核心结论是：*"finite temperature data from Fermi-Hubbard quantum simulators can be well captured by RVB states"*。

### I Introduction
**问题背景：掺杂 Hubbard 模型的长期难题**  
掺杂 **Fermi-Hubbard model** 的自旋—电荷耦合是凝聚态中的经典难题。原文将其定位为 *"an outstanding challenge in condensed matter physics for decades"*。难点不在方程本身，而在有限掺杂、有限温度下的强关联竞争机制。

**RVB 物理图景：空穴在 singlet 覆盖中的运动**  
Anderson 的 RVB 图景把基态写成一组 **singlet coverings** 的叠加，空穴作为 **holons** 在其中运动。原文用 *"free ‘holons’ moving through a spin liquid comprised of singlet coverings"* 和 *"superposition of different coverings of the lattice with singlets"* 描述这一机制。

**Gutzwiller 投影：把强 U 极限嵌入试探态**  
RVB 变分态写成 **|ψ⟩ = P_G |ψ_0⟩**，其中 **P_G** 投影掉双占据，直接对应 **U \gg t** 的物理极限。原文明确指出 *"projects out double occupancies"*，并强调这种构造既保留**费米反对称性**，又让参数数目极少、可高效评估。

**方法论定位：能解释高温关联，但不覆盖全部低能现象**  
早期工作已说明投影 d-wave 态能解释部分实验量，例如 nodal Fermi velocity、quasiparticle weight、Drude weight、superfluid density；但 **Fermi arcs** 和 **stripe phase** 无法由该 ansatz 捕捉。原文的限定语是 *"cannot be captured by the RVB ansatz"*，同时又指出它仍能在较高温度下处理一般的**correlation functions**。

**研究目标：面向方格与三角晶格的有限温度实验数据**  
这里直接把有限温度实验快照与 **RVB** 态对齐，利用 **gradient descent** 选取最优参数。原文目标是 *"obtain the best possible description in terms of resonating valence bond states"*，并特别强调 **square** 与 **triangular lattice** 两类几何。

### II Model and Trial States
**基本哈密顿量：Fermi-Hubbard 到 t-J 的强耦合极限**  
哈密顿量写成 **H_FH = -t Σ(c†c + h.c.) + U Σ n↑n↓**，在 **U \gg t** 下近似为 **t-J model**：
**H_tJ = -t P_G(Σ c†c + h.c.)P_G + J Σ(S_i·S_j - n_in_j/4)**。这里的 **J = 4t²/U** 是关键标度，表明反铁磁交换从虚跃迁中涌现。

**平均场重写：引入通量与 Néel 场**  
通过自旋算符 **S_i = 1/2 Σ c†σc** 并做平均场分解，得到 **H_MF**，其两类核心参数是**键相位 ϕ_ij** 和 **交错磁场 h**。原文写得很直接：*"the mean field Hamiltonian"* 包含 *"e^{i\phi_{ij}}"* 与 *"h\sum_{i,\sigma}\sigma e^{iQ\cdot R_i}c^{\dagger}c"*，其中 **Q=(π,π)**。

**方格晶格：staggered flux 的键相位结构**  
方格晶格上，最近邻只有 **x/y** 两类，键相位按奇偶子晶格交错：
偶/奇格点沿 x、y 方向分别取 **±ϕ/4**。这一结构对应 **staggered flux state**，把局域环流和 π-flux 类物理纳入 ansatz。

**三角晶格：增加对角键并重定义通量结构**  
三角晶格通过在方格上加入对角连接 **j=i+x+y** 实现，键相位变为四类最近邻加一类对角邻居，且对角键取 **±ϕ/2**。原文给出 *"We analyze the triangular lattice in a similar fashion"*，并注明三角晶格分析中取 **h=0**。

**有限温度密度矩阵：热占据再做 Gutzwiller 投影**  
先对 **H_MF** 对角化，得到 Slater 行列式本征态 **|α_k⟩** 和能量 **E_{α_k}**，再按热分布构造 **ρ_MF**，最终得到投影后的密度矩阵：
**ρ = (1/Z) P_G(Σ |α_k⟩⟨α_k| e^{-β_MF E_{α_k}})P_G**。原文关键句是 *"A finite temperature mean field state"* 与 *"directly apply the Gutzwiller projection"*。

**可观测量估计：Metropolis 采样下的 p 与 f**  
通过 **p(α_r, α_k)** 作为概率分布在 \\{(α_r,α_k)\\} 上做 **Metropolis sampling**，并用 **f(α_r, α_k)** 估计算符期望值。关键公式给出 **⟨Ô⟩ = Tr(ρ̂Ô)**，而采样约束明确为 *"restricting the states ... to configurations with at most singly occupied sites"*。

### III Optimization Method
**目标函数：把实验关联函数当作拟合目标**  
把实验或参考数据中的关联函数 **C_O^{ref}(d)** 与 Monte Carlo 估计 **C_O^{MC}(d)** 做等权平方差，定义
**L = Σ_O Σ_d [C_O^{ref}(d) - C_O^{MC}(d)]²**。原文直接写明这是 *"the equally weighted sum of squared difference"*。

**梯度获取：对所有变分参数做 MC 估计**  
梯度写成 **∂L/∂ξ_l = 2 Σ [C^{MC}-C^{ref}] ∂C^{MC}/∂ξ_l**，并通过采样估计。参数 **ξ_l** 就是 **ϕ、T_MF/J_MF、h/J_MF**。原文强调 *"estimate the gradients of L with respect to all variational parameters"*。

**核心技巧：把导数改写成可采样形式**  
对相关函数的导数重写为含 **Θ_l** 和 **Φ_l** 的 Monte Carlo 平均，
**F(α_r,α_k)=Θ_l-\bar{Θ}_l+1/2(Φ_l-\bar{Φ}_l)**。原文说明 *"We reformulate the derivative"*，并用有限差分近似这些导数。

**优化策略：梯度下降**  
最后用 **gradient descent** 更新参数。方法本质上是“**可微分的投影热态拟合**”，而不是黑箱搜索。

### IV Benchmarks
**三组基准：零温方格、有限温方格、有限温三角**  
先在已知答案上检验方法：**(1) zero temperature square lattice, (2) finite temperature square lattice, (3) finite temperature triangular lattice**。其中 case 1 固定 **T_MF/J_MF = 0**，case 3 固定 **h/J_MF = 0**。

**相关函数选择：只用少数距离做训练**  
目标函数只取**自旋-自旋相关** **C_S(|d|)**，方格用 **d=1** 和 **d=√8**，三角用 **d=1** 和 **d=2**。原文说明 *"we consider distances d = 1 and d = 8 for the square lattice and d = 1 and d = 2 for the triangular lattice"*，以同时兼顾短程与长程效应。

**收敛速度：约 35 步内到 10^-5 量级**  
优化通常在 **≈35 optimization steps** 内把目标函数压到 **10^-5** 量级，而对应的最近邻自旋关联本身只有 **10^-1** 量级。原文写得非常明确：*"within about 35 optimization steps"*、*"values of orders of at most 10^{-5}"*。

**参数不可唯一识别：多个变分参数给出相似关联**  
即使能把目标函数降得很低，也往往无法恢复初始参数；不同参数组合产生近似相同的相关函数和能量。原文直接指出 *"it is not possible to recover the exact initial parameters"*，并提到与地态计算一样存在“参数退化”的景观。

**QMC Heisenberg 基准：温度升高时 h/T_MF 下降**  
在二维方格 Heisenberg 模型的 QMC 参考数据上，优化把 **T/J = 0.1 到 1.3** 的温度序列拟合到 **SFN** 态。结果显示 **h/T_MF** 随温度升高而下降，说明 **Néel order** 减弱；同时 **T_MF/J_MF** 随 **T/J** 升高而增大，且在高温下因最近邻项主导出现部分偏差。

**通量参数的温度依赖：低温接近 0.35π，高温趋向 0 或 2π**  
低温时最优 **ϕ** 常接近 **0.35π**，与地态 RVB 结果一致；最高温 **T/J=1.3** 时，多数 **ϕ** 接近 **0** 或 **2π**。原文把这与 *"a state with zero flux for higher temperatures (uniform RVB)"* 联系起来。

### V Square Lattice
**实验数据一：Chiu et al. 2019 的空穴掺杂方格晶格**  
这里分析 **hole doping, δ<0**，同时拟合 **自旋-自旋相关 C_Z(|d|)** 与 **dopant-dopant correlator C_D(|d|)**。实验参数为 **U/t = 8.1**，估计温度 **T/J ≈ 0.65**。参考距离包括 **C_Z** 的 **d=1、√2、2**，以及 **C_D** 的 **d=√2**。

**实验数据二：Xu et al. 2023 的空穴/粒子双侧掺杂**  
第二组数据覆盖 **δ ≈ -0.5 到 0.55**，只给出 **C_Z(d=1, √2)**。模型参数为 **U/t ≈ 9**，温度 **T/J ≲ 0.8**。这里允许参数随掺杂变化，做“每个 doped point 一次优化”。

**优化设置：每个掺杂点 10 次独立运行，最多 300 步**  
对每个数据点都做 **ten runs with different initial parameters**，每次最多 **300 optimization steps**。在方格晶格的有限温度区间内，**h/J_MF** 被固定为 **0**，因为高温下 Néel 场已经很小。

**自旋关联：整体拟合良好，但 √2 距离的符号翻转最难**  
优化后的 **SF state** 对所有纳入的距离都能较好重建 **C_Z(d)**，甚至对未纳入优化的 **d=2** 也有一定泛化；但 **d=√2** 在大掺杂区域的**符号变化**无法正确捕捉。原文直说 *"cannot accurately capture the sign change"*，且把部分半填充误差归因于**non-converged optimizations**。

**双占据的影响：最近邻相关被污染，但投影态无法直接表达**  
实验图像里虚双占据会被映射成两个空位，而在 **Gutzwiller projection** 中这类过程被排除。原文指出这些 **doublon-hole fluctuations** 在 **d=1** 上几乎占主导，因此对最近邻关联的比较会受到影响。

**dopant-dopant 相关：优于固定 π-flux 态**  
对 **\tilde{g}^{(2)}(d)=C_D(d)/δ²+1** 的拟合与实验较一致，且明显优于固定 **π-flux state**。原文强调 *"our ansatz performs significantly better"*，说明优化参数确实提升了对掺杂空穴结构的描述能力。

**掺杂依赖：高掺杂趋近自由费米子，低掺杂更像 Heisenberg 极限**  
方格上洞掺杂与粒子掺杂等价，因此看 **|δ|**。当 **|δ|≈50%** 时系统更像自由费米子，最优 **J_MF** 趋向 **t**；而半填充附近更接近 **Heisenberg model**，最优 **J_MF=J=4t²/U**，对应 **T_MF/J_MF** 较高。原文总结为 *"the optimized mean field temperature is thus higher at small dopings and decreases in the large doping regime"*。

### VI Triangular Lattice
**粒子-空穴不对称：三角晶格呈现更强的非对称性**  
三角晶格中的 **C_Z(d)** 对粒子掺杂与空穴掺杂不再等价，表现出明显 **particle-hole asymmetry**。优化态能抓住整体形状及部分符号变化，但对**大粒子掺杂**区的行为拟合不足。原文写明 *"We are unable to capture the behavior of the spin correlations accurately for large particle doping"*。

**符号变化：低掺杂时可再现部分 sign structure**  
对于 **d = √3**（文中对应三角晶格的特征距离）附近的关联，低掺杂情况下能捕捉不同符号；但当粒子掺杂增大时，符号变化会失配。图 1B 还显示三角晶格的 **C_DZZ** 在**hole doped regime** 比较好，而在 **particle doped regime** 被低估。

**参数选择：三角晶格取 h = 0，重点优化 flux 与有效温度**  
三角晶格计算中直接固定 **h=0**，因此主要自由度是 **ϕ** 与 **T_MF/J_MF**。这使得模型更接近**staggered flux state**，也更容易检查纯通量/有效温度能否解释三角晶格数据。

**可重建的现象：连接相关的 sign change 可被复现**  
尽管幅值仍有偏差，连通关联 **C_DZZ** 的符号变化仍能复现。原文在图 1B 中强调 *"the sign change for the connected correlator C_{DZZ} can be reproduced"*，说明模型在拓扑/符号层面仍具解释力。

## 第四部分：深度理解与语言支持 (Understanding & Nuance)
**Gutzwiller projection**  
不是普通“筛选态”，而是把多体波函数投影到**无双占据**子空间。学术语境里它把强关联极限 **U \gg t** 直接编码进态矢，而不是只写进哈密顿量。

**Resonating valence bond (RVB)**  
指多种**价键 singlet 覆盖**的量子叠加。与“静态反铁磁序”不同，RVB强调**量子涨落**和**局域成键的共振**，因此可兼容自旋液体与掺杂后的强关联态。

**Staggered flux state**  
并非简单“有磁通的态”，而是键相位按子晶格交错分布，使局域环流在晶格上呈交替结构。它与 **π-flux**、**uniform RVB** 同属紧束缚平均场家族，但磁通分布不同，物理含义也不同。

**Mean-field temperature T_MF**  
不是实验温度本身，而是试探态内部的**有效热参数**。它通过 \\( eta_{MF}=1/T_{MF}\\) 进入热权重，实际反映的是最优平均场能谱与数据所要求的“混合程度”。

**Doublon-hole fluctuations**  
指单个双占据与空位成对出现的虚过程。在实验成像里可能被误识别为两个空位，因此会污染 **dopant** 相关函数；在 **Gutzwiller projected** 试探态中这类过程被直接排除，所以对比时会出现系统性差异。

**疑难概念：为什么参数“恢复不唯一”仍然有意义**  
这个现象不表示模型失败，而是说明关联函数对参数是**多对一映射**。只要不同参数产生几乎相同的**局域与中程相关**，就意味着数据不足以唯一判别微观态，但足以约束一个**有效物理区域**。这在变分 ansatz 中很常见，尤其是当目标函数只包含少数距离的 correlators 时。

## 第五部分：创新评估与关联 (Synthesis & Novelty)
**新颖性一：把“可解释变分态”做成数据驱动反演工具**  
过去 2–5 年里，冷原子 Hubbard 研究更多聚焦在直接测量、数值模拟或固定参数的理论拟合；这里把 **RVB/Gutzwiller projected** 态升级为一个**可训练的物理解释器**，通过实验数据反推 **ϕ、T_MF/J_MF、h/J_MF**，属于从“拟合理论”向“物理参数反演”推进。

**新颖性二：有限温度投影 RVB 同时处理方格与三角几何**  
相关工作常局限于半填充、零温或单一晶格。这里同时处理 **square** 与 **triangular lattice**，并把 **finite-temperature** 作为核心对象，说明该框架不是只对理想化基态有效，而能覆盖真实实验温区 **T/J≈0.65–0.8** 甚至 **0.1–1.3** 的基准数据。

**新颖性三：未参与训练的高阶关联仍能被预测**  
能从若干二点函数外推到**三点相关**，说明 ansatz 不只是局部插值，而是保留了正确的低维相关结构。原文的关键点是 *"even when they are not specifically used in the optimization"*，这在关联多体系统里很重要。

**新颖性四：参数的物理可读性比纯黑箱更强**

abstract: arXiv:2608.18714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned models are replacing first-principles calculations across materials discovery, and physical symmetry is the central guarantee built into them. The debate over how much symmetry to hard-wire rather than learn has run on rotations, where a symmetry error is an approximation error. Some constraints are exact: symmetry forces certain property tensors to exactly zero, so a nonzero prediction is physically impossible rather than inaccurate. Here we show that whether a model can make such predictions is decided before training by one rarely reported design bit, whether its features carry parity labels, and derive a criterion, the parity gap, that computes from group theory alone which properties and crystals are exposed. Across matched architecture pairs differing only in that bit, evaluated on two thousand centrosymmetric crystals whose piezoelectric tensor must vanish, parity-labelled arms sit at the floating-point floor while rotation-only arms predict forbidden responses on 90-96% of crystals, six orders of magnitude apart, at no accuracy cost. Training on explicit zeros does not recover exactness, and a head on a frozen universal potential inherits its backbone's symmetry group. One reflection at random initialization verifies the label in seconds.

# 第一部分：核心概览（Overview）

核心贡献是揭示：材料机器学习模型能否对**对称性严格禁止的物性给出非零预测**，在训练前就由一个常被忽略的设计位决定，即特征是否携带**宇称（parity）标签**。通过群论定义“**宇称缺口**”并在 2,000 个中心对称绝缘晶体上进行匹配消融，结果显示，携带宇称的 **O(3)-等变模型**将压电张量误差压至浮点精度，而仅具 **SO(3)-等变性**的模型在 90–96% 晶体上产生物理不可能的响应，差距约六个数量级且无精度代价。该工作将“对称性近似误差”与“物理禁戒量非零”明确区分，并把宇称从实现细节提升为材料基础模型的物理可靠性标准。

# 第二部分：结构化快速回顾

《A single design choice determines whether machine learning models of materials make physically impossible predictions》（None，）

## 背景

材料机器学习广泛替代第一性原理计算，**E(3)-等变网络**成为分子与晶体建模的标准构造。旋转等变性通常只要求预测按对称操作近似变换；但对于某些晶体—物性组合，对称性要求张量严格为零。压电张量是典型例子：中心反演使其同时保持不变并变号，因此必须恒等为零。

## 方法

用群论定义**宇称缺口**：

\[
\gamma_r(G)=\dim V^{G^+}-\dim V^G
\]

其中 \(G\) 是晶体点群，\(G^+\) 是其 proper-rotation 子群，\(V\) 是目标张量空间。构造 NequIP、Allegro、MACE 的成对模型，唯一差异是特征宇称标签：一组为 **O(3)**，另一组将所有特征声明为偶宇称、仅具 **SO(3)** 等变性。实验覆盖 2,000 个经 `spglib` 验证的中心对称绝缘晶体、4 类目标、3 个随机种子，共 84 次运行。

## 结果

对于三阶压电张量：

- O(3) 模型在 18,000 个结构—运行组合中没有一次超过 \(0.01\,\mathrm{C\,m^{-2}}\)；
- SO(3) 模型在 90–96% 晶体上超过该阈值；
- 两类模型的中位数相差约 \(10^6\) 倍；
- O(3) 模型的非零残差处于浮点运算底部；
- SO(3) 模型的典型非零响应接近真实压电张量的幅度；
- 额外加入零标签、增加零样本数量或提高损失权重，只能缩小响应，不能恢复结构性精确零。

## 讨论

是否携带宇称标签，而不是目标张量本身是否为奇宇称，决定了物理禁戒响应能否从架构上被排除。偶秩张量的宇称缺口恒为零，因此介电张量和弹性张量不会暴露于该问题。冻结的通用势也无法由新训练的读出头恢复缺失的宇称保证；读出头继承骨干网络的对称性群。

## 局限

提供的论文文本在“**A parity-even rank**”处截断，未包含完整的后续章节、补充材料、全部数值表、完整统计结果及正式讨论和结论。因此，关于训练集构成、具体 MAE、Wilcoxon 检验统计量、置信区间数值、计算成本以及所有基线模型的完整比较，只能依据正文中已经给出的信息概括。

## 结论

对奇秩极性张量，特征是否显式携带宇称标签决定模型能否严格排除对称性禁止的预测。**O(3) 宇称等变性提供参数无关、训练无关的零值保证；SO(3) 等变性只能提供较弱的旋转约束。**

# 第三部分：逐章节冷凝解析

## Introduction

**材料模型的结构性能力具有直接物理后果。**  
材料发现越来越依赖机器学习替代第一性原理计算，因此模型“结构上能够预测什么”不再只是工程问题，而是物理可靠性问题。原文将这一点表述为：*"what an architecture is structurally able to predict now carries direct physical consequences."* **等变神经网络**通过规定特征在空间群或点群作用下的变换规律，将物理对称性写入模型。

**E(3)-等变模型并不自动意味着完整的 O(3) 对称性。**  
三维欧氏群 \(E(3)\) 包含旋转、平移、反射和空间反演；但部分模型只对 proper rotations 等变，即只实现 **SO(3)**，不处理反射和反演。关键事实是：*"E(3) contains improper operations: reflections and the spatial inversion \(I:\mathbf r\mapsto-\mathbf r\)."* 因此，“E(3)-equivariant”不能仅凭角动量截断或旋转等变性推断，必须检查是否保留了 **parity labels**。

**旋转约束通常是近似误差，而宇称导致的零值约束可以是绝对的。**  
旋转等变性要求：

\[
f(Qx)\approx D(Q)f(x)
\]

轻微偏离仍可视为可度量、可优化的近似误差。相反，在中心对称晶体中，压电张量必须满足：

\[
e=-e
\]

所以 \(e=0\) 是代数必然性。原文明确区分两类错误：*"Rotational equivariance is an approximation target"*，而非零的禁戒响应是 *"physically impossible rather than inaccurate."*

**中心反演使压电张量成为无标签的物理检验工具。**  
压电张量 \(e_{ijk}\) 是三阶极性张量，秩 \(r=3\)，在空间反演下获得因子 \((-1)^3=-1\)。中心对称晶体的点群包含反演，因此 Neumann 原理要求张量在反演下不变，而张量表示要求其变号，二者共同推出张量恒等为零。230 个空间群中有 92 个中心对称空间群，提供了大规模、无需参考计算的禁戒样本。

**宇称标签决定保证能否在训练前存在。**  
若特征携带自然宇称 \((-1)^l\)，网络对 \(O(3)\) 等变，中心对称结构上的奇宇称输出可在任意参数值下严格为零。若所有特征被声明为偶宇称，网络仍可保持精确旋转等变，却没有反演变换规律来强制该零值。原文概括为：*"A model missing the labels remains exactly rotation-equivariant and loses nothing on approximation targets. On the exact constraints it loses everything."*

**宇称缺口把暴露风险变成可计算量。**  
对于目标张量空间 \(V\)，定义：

\[
\gamma_r(G)=\dim V^{G^+}-\dim V^G
\]

它衡量 proper rotations 允许、但完整点群连同宇称会禁止的分量数。对偶秩 \(r\)，\(\gamma_r=0\)；对奇秩 \(r\)，\(\gamma_r=\dim V^{G^+}\)。三阶压电张量在中心对称三斜晶系 \(\bar 1\) 中达到最大值 18，即整个 18 维张量空间都依赖宇称来排除。

**研究设计包含四个层次。**  
第一，利用群论在建模前预测暴露程度；第二，在 2,000 个中心对称绝缘晶体上测量禁戒响应；第三，测试显式零标签、样本扩增、损失重加权和测试时反演平均是否能修复问题；第四，审计已发布架构并检验冻结通用势的读出头是否继承骨干网络的对称性。原文将目标概括为：*"Here we establish that this design decision governs what deployed models predict, in four steps."*

## Results

### What parity guarantees, and what its absence costs

**模型假设包括置换不变性、平移不变性和空间等变性。**  
结构 \(x\) 映射到秩 \(r\) 极性张量空间 \(V\)，表示为：

\[
D(Q)=Q^{\otimes r},\qquad D(I)=(-1)^r\mathrm{id}
\]

实验统一采用三个假设：

- **A1：置换不变性**，同元素原子重新编号不改变输出；
- **A2：平移不变性**，整体刚性平移以及单原子跨晶格矢量平移不改变输出；
- **A3：\(\mathcal G\)-等变性**，\(f_\theta(Qx)=D(Q)f_\theta(x)\)。

带宇称标签时 \(\mathcal G=O(3)\)，否则 \(\mathcal G=SO(3)\)。A2 中的刚性平移尤其重要，因为非对称空间群的操作可能同时包含旋转与分数平移。原文称其为：*"The rigid-shift clause of (A2) is load-bearing."*

**中心对称结构在无宇称条件下已经满足一个较弱的反演恒等式。**  
对于中心对称晶体，反演后的周期结构只是原结构的原子重标记与晶格平移。因此仅凭 A1 和 A2 就有：

\[
f_\theta(Ix)=f_\theta(x)
\]

但这不是目标张量在 \(O(3)\) 下应有的反演变换，而是模型因看不见重标记和平移而得到的结构恒等式。只有把该恒等式与奇宇称变换 \(D(I)=-\mathrm{id}\) 结合，才能推出输出为零。

**定理 1 给出宇称缺口的严格判据。**  
对中心对称晶体，若目标秩 \(r\) 为奇数且模型满足 \(O(3)\)-等变性，则：

\[
f_\theta(x)=0\quad\text{for every }\theta
\]

若模型只有 \(SO(3)\)-等变性，则输出只被限制在 proper-rotation 不变子空间 \(V^{G^+}\) 中，而非完整点群允许的 \(V^G\)。差异维度就是 \(\gamma_r(G)\)。原文的核心表述是：*"If \(f_\theta\) also satisfies (A3) with \(\mathcal G=O(3)\) and \(r\) is odd, then \(f_\theta(x)=0\) for every \(\theta\)."*

**宇称缺口在偶秩上恒为零。**  
由中心反演的表示因子 \((-1)^r\) 可知，偶秩目标在反演下不变，宇称不能额外消灭任何分量。因此：

- 介电张量 \(r=2\)：\(\gamma=0\)；
- 弹性张量 \(r=4\)：\(\gamma=0\)；
- 三阶压电张量 \(r=3\)：可能具有非零缺口。

这意味着宇称标签不是对所有任务都同样关键，而是只在目标张量与晶体点群共同产生非零缺口时关键。

**三阶压电张量在十一个中心对称晶类中有十类暴露。**  
表 1 给出：

| 晶类 | \(G\) | \(G^+\) | \(\gamma_1\) | \(\gamma_3\) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| \(\bar 1\) | 1 | 1 | 3 | 18 |
| \(2/m\) | 2 | 2 | 1 | 8 |
| mmm | mmm | 222 | 0 | 3 |
| \(4/m\) | 4/m | 4 | 1 | 4 |
| \(4/mmm\) | 4/mmm | 422 | 0 | 1 |
| \(\bar 3\) | \(\bar3\) | 3 | 1 | 6 |
| \(\bar3m\) | \(\bar3m\) | 32 | 0 | 2 |
| \(6/m\) | 6/m | 6 | 1 | 4 |
| \(6/mmm\) | 6/mmm | 622 | 0 | 1 |
| \(\bar3\)m | \(\bar3\)m | 23 | 0 | 1 |
| \(m\bar3m\) | \(m\bar3m\) | 432 | 0 | 0 |

这些数值由群的 Reynolds 投影精确计算，不依赖模型、数据集或训练参数。原文强调：*"Entries are computed exactly from the point groups by Reynolds projection, with no model, dataset or trained parameter involved."*

**宇称缺口不是纯理论允许性，而是实际模型是否利用该自由度的经验问题。**  
定理只能说明 SO(3) 模型“可以”输出某些禁戒分量，不能证明训练后一定会输出。实验因此测量实际非零响应的频率与幅度。文中明确指出：*"Theorems of this kind forbid and permit; whether the permission is taken up, and on how many crystals, is an empirical question."*

### Parity labels decide whether impossible predictions occur

**四类目标用于区分目标宇称与评估群体缺口。**  
实验比较：

- QM9 内能 \(U_0\)：偶宇称，\(\gamma=0\)；
- QM9 偶极：奇宇称，但 10,831 个分子中仅 7 个具有对称性强制零；
- 弹性张量：偶秩，\(\gamma=0\)；
- 压电张量：奇秩，且在 2,000 个中心对称晶体中大部分具有非零缺口。

因此真正决定模型分离的是“奇宇称 + 非零缺口”，而不是奇宇称本身。

**匹配消融只改变一个设计位。**  
NequIP、Allegro 和 MACE 各构造两组模型：

- \(O(3)\) 组：球谐特征携带自然宇称 \((-1)^l\)；
- \(SO(3)\) 组：所有特征声明为偶宇称。

两组共享架构、超参数、数据划分和随机种子。每组的 \(l_{\max}=3\)。EqV2 作为未经改动的旋转-only 模型加入比较。总实验量为：

\[
7\ \text{arms}\times4\ \text{targets}\times3\ \text{seeds}=84\ \text{runs}
\]

宇称差异在训练前通过验证门检查：O(3) 组同时满足旋转和反射律，SO(3) 组满足旋转律但违反反射律。

**SO(3) 组并非容量不足，反而拥有更多参数。**  
所有特征设为偶宇称会打开额外的张量积路径，因此 SO(3) 组参数量比对应 O(3) 组多 0.2%–39.8%。这排除了“SO(3) 误差来自模型容量不足”的简单解释。原文指出：*"Capacity runs the wrong way to explain a deficit."*

**O(3) 模型在 18,000 个结构—运行组合中没有超过物理阈值。**  
在 2,000 个理想化中心对称晶体上，每个模型、每个种子都进行预测，共：

\[
2{,}000\times 3\ \text{cores}\times 3\ \text{seeds}=18{,}000
\]

O(3) 预测没有一次超过：

\[
\tau=0.01\ \mathrm{C\,m^{-2}}
\]

最大单次预测甚至比浮点算术底部低 7.6 倍。原文为：*"Not one of the 18,000 O(3) structure-runs exceeds the operating threshold of 0.01 C m\(^{-2}\)."*

**SO(3) 模型在 90–96% 晶体上产生物理禁戒响应。**  
SO(3) 模型超过 \(\tau\) 的晶体比例为 90%–96%，称为 **false flags**。其中位数响应接近训练集中真实压电张量的典型幅度，说明这不是微小数值噪声，而是具有物理响应量级的错误预测。原文称：*"the typical SO(3) prediction is the size of a real response, not a numerical residue."*

**两类模型的差距约为六个数量级。**  
NequIP 成对模型的中位数比约为：

\[
2\times10^6
\]

总体描述为六个数量级分离。SO(3) 的低尾主要来自 \(m\bar3m\) 晶体，因为这些晶体的 \(\gamma_3=0\)，proper rotations 已足以强制压电张量为零。

**结果对池化方式、阈值和坐标变体具有稳健性。**  
由于求和读出是 extensive、压电张量是 intensive，研究还训练了 mean-pooled 模型并重新校准阈值。O(3) 的 false-flag 比例在所有核心和种子下仍为零；SO(3) 比例的变化均值仅为 0.0065，低于随机种子波动。阈值跨越四个数量级时，两类模型仍保持清晰分离；理想化坐标与 DFT 松弛后的 raw 坐标之间，SO(3) 比例基本不变。

**一个 raw 坐标异常揭示了数据筛选误差。**  
O(3) 一侧唯一出现的小响应来自一个 raw 结构。进一步检查发现，该结构按选择容差并不真正中心对称。这说明宇称保证不仅能验证模型，也能检测数据中的对称性标注或结构筛选错误。原文称：*"the guarantee detected a data artefact."*

**统计检验支持模型间差异。**  
结构配对的 Wilcoxon 检验在每个核心和随机种子上均拒绝两组相等假设；不同随机种子间的逐结构违反幅度具有相关性；不同架构识别出的高风险晶体高度一致。提供的正文没有给出具体 Wilcoxon \(P\) 值，因此不能进一步报告精确显著性数值。

### Parity costs nothing where the gap is zero

**在宇称缺口为零的任务上，宇称标签没有可见精度代价。**  
对 \(U_0\)、偶极和弹性张量，O(3) 与 SO(3) 模型在随机种子噪声范围内不可区分。偶极和弹性任务中，O(3) 在三个核心上 nominally 更好，效应量为 0.04–0.74 个合并标准差，但只有 3 个种子，无法声称显著性。内能任务的优劣方向随模型变化。

**偶极任务证明“目标奇宇称”本身不是充分条件。**  
偶极是秩 1 奇宇称目标，但在 10,831 个 QM9 分子中仅 7 个分子受到对称性强制零约束。因此两组模型整体精度匹配。真正的区分因素是：

\[
\text{目标奇宇称}\ +\ \text{评估结构上的非零 }\gamma
\]

原文明确总结：*"What separates the arms is not the target’s parity but a nonzero gap on the crystals evaluated."*

**在压电任务上，O(3) 同时具有更低的普通回归误差和更强的物理保证。**  
三个匹配核心中，O(3) 的压电测试误差均低于 SO(3)，且 O(3) 参数更少。EqV2 在非中心对称晶体上的普通回归误差相近，却几乎普遍产生中心对称晶体 false flags，说明普通 MAE 不能替代严格对称性验证。

### Training cannot buy the zero

**显式加入中心对称零标签无法恢复结构性精确零。**  
每个 SO(3) 模型的训练集加入 1,000 个经 `spglib` 验证的中心对称晶体，并赋予精确零标签。即使在这些训练过的晶体上测试，仍有 89.5%–92.2% 被错误标记为非零：

\[
\text{false-flag fraction}=0.895\text{--}0.922
\]

零标签样本的训练误差反而优于真实张量样本，因此问题不是简单欠拟合。

**增加零样本数量只能降低幅度，不能让大多数预测变成零。**  
NequIP SO(3) 的零样本注入量从 250 增至 16,000 时，留出集违反中位数从：

\[
0.666\rightarrow0.077\ \mathrm{C\,m^{-2}}
\]

下降 8.6 倍，但 false-flag 比例只从 0.895 降至 0.858。模型学会了“更小的非零”，没有学会结构上恒等为零。原文概括为：*"The predictions shrink; almost none becomes zero."*

**损失重加权仍无法获得严格零。**  
把零标签样本权重提高 100 倍后，训练样本上的 false-flag 比例下降 0.22，但仍有约三分之二被标记；任何权重都没有达到 O(3) 架构无需训练即可提供的精确零。

**测试时反演平均在特定模型上有效，但不等于恢复了宇称。**  
采用：

\[
T_{\mathrm{sym}}(x)=\frac{f_\theta(x)-f_\theta(Ix)}{2}
\]

对精确 SO(3) 核心，false-flag 比例降为零。但因为 A1 和 A2 已经保证 \(f_\theta(Ix)=f_\theta(x)\)，该操作对任意置换、平移不变模型都将结果消为零，并没有从特征内部恢复反演对称性。它还需要预先知道目标宇称；对近似等变的 EqV2 无法成立，false-flag 比例仍为 0.82。

### The guarantee tracks the physics of symmetry breaking

**沿真实对称性破缺路径，O(3) 保证在破缺点准确关闭。**  
研究将金红石 TiO\(_2\) 沿极性模式移动，设置 33 个经对称性验证的振幅，从中心对称母相一直到超过物理畸变的区域。O(3) 预测从算术底部平滑升高；SO(3) 在零畸变处就存在比 O(3) 高 5–6 个数量级的伪响应，并在小畸变区压过真实物理信号。

金红石 \(4/mmm\) 的：

\[
\gamma_3(4/mmm)=1
\]

说明母相中恰有一个分量只能依靠宇称被排除。相同模式在金红石型 SnO\(_2\) 和锐钛矿 TiO\(_2\) 上复现。

**\(\gamma_3=0\) 的晶体构成 SO(3) 模型可正确处理的上限。**  
三个匹配核心在 \(m\bar3m\) 晶体上均不产生 false flag，在其他晶体上标记 97.6%–99.2%。因此精确 SO(3) 模型的正确率上限由群论直接给出：它能依赖 proper rotations 处理 \(\gamma_3=0\) 的类别，但不能处理 \(\gamma_3>0\) 的类别。

EqV2 因近似等变性超过这一理论上限，在 \(m\bar3m\) 中也会错误标记 53.4% 的结构，贡献总体 false-flag 率的 4.4 个百分点。

**宇称保证可以延伸到预测对原子位置的 Jacobian。**  
对：

\[
J=\frac{\partial f_\theta}{\partial\mathbf r}
\]

在中心对称几何处，O(3) 模型使 Jacobian 的偶宇称子空间能量比例严格为零。实验覆盖 20 个晶体、19 个空间群，所有 Jacobian 均通过有限差分验证；两类模型在该指标上再次相差 5–6 个数量级。由此，O(3) 不只规定“输出为零”，还规定哪些原子位移能够激活该响应。

**具体材料案例验证两种对称性机制。**  
- 刚玉 Al\(_2\)O\(_3\)：\(\gamma_3=2\)，只有宇称能排除响应；SO(3) 给出接近完整响应幅度；
- 岩盐和金刚石结构 \(m\bar3m\) 化合物：\(\gamma_3=0\)，旋转本身已足够强制零；
- 72 个匹配核心 SO(3) 预测在 \(m\bar3m\) 化合物上的范围为：

\[
5.7\times10^{-10}\text{--}3.2\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{C\,m^{-2}}
\]

- EqV2 在金刚石和 SrTiO\(_3\) 上超过阈值，体现其近似等变性的缺陷。

GotenNet 的向量输出在 improper operation 下符合极性向量律，误差为 \(1.8\times10^{-15}\)，而伪向量律误差为 1.9。eSEN、UMA 和 EqV3 对旋转律的误差为 \(10^{-5}\)–\(10^{-4}\)，却以 order unity 的幅度违反镜像律。ICTP 的三阶输出在机器精度上呈奇宇称。原文总结为：*"One reflection at random initialization verifies the label in seconds."*

**冻结骨干网络的读出头继承上游对称性群。**

# 第四部分：深度理解与语言支持

## 术语解析

**Parity**

在这里不是普通意义上的“奇偶性”，而是物理对象在**空间反演** \(\mathbf r\mapsto-\mathbf r\) 下的变换符号。自然球谐通道 \(l\) 的宇称为 \((-1)^l\)。奇宇称对象在反演下变号，偶宇称对象保持不变。它与“张量秩奇偶”相关，但不能简单等同于“所有秩为奇数的对象都自动产生可测零值”；是否暴露还取决于晶体点群的 proper-rotation 不变子空间。

**Improper operation**

指不保持空间定向的正交操作，包括反射和反演，行列式为 \(-1\)。旋转属于 proper operation，行列式为 \(+1\)。因此 \(SO(3)\) 只包含旋转，\(O(3)\) 同时包含旋转、反射和反演。论文的核心技术区别正是 \(SO(3)\) 与 \(O(3)\) 之间是否包含 improper operations。

**Parity gap**

可译为“宇称缺口”或“宇称暴露维数”。它不是模型误差，而是由晶体点群和目标张量表示直接计算出的维数：

\[
\gamma_r(G)=\dim V^{G^+}-\dim V^G
\]

若 \(\gamma_r>0\)，说明只使用旋转约束的模型仍有若干个分量可以输出，而完整对称性要求这些分量为零。它量化的是“缺少宇称标签会暴露多少个禁戒自由度”。

**Neumann’s principle**

Neumann 原理要求晶体物性张量至少具有晶体点群的全部对称性。它不是经验规律，也不是训练数据统计趋势，而是对物性张量变换规律的群论约束。对于中心反演晶体和奇宇称张量，原理直接导致张量恒等为零。

**False flag**

这里不是分类器意义上的普通假阳性，而是模型在已知物理真值严格为零的结构上输出超过操作阈值的响应。研究设置 \(\tau=0.01\,\mathrm{C\,m^{-2}}\)，超过该值的预测被称为 false flag。由于真实压电张量在这些中心对称晶体上严格为零，这种 false flag 具有“物理不可能”含义，而不是仅仅预测偏差较大。

## 疑难查证

**为什么 SO(3) 模型会在中心对称晶体上输出非零？**  
中心对称晶体满足 \(Ix\) 与 \(x\) 在周期结构意义下相同。A1 和 A2 使任何模型都有：

\[
f(Ix)=f(x)
\]

如果模型还具有奇宇称的反演变换，则应同时满足：

\[
f(Ix)=-f(x)
\]

两式合并得到 \(f(x)=0\)。但 SO(3) 模型没有反演变换规则，因此第二式不存在。它只知道 proper rotations 如何作用，不知道反演应使 rank-3 polar tensor 变号，于是可以保留 \(V^{G^+}\) 中的非零分量。

**为什么训练零标签不能等价于架构保证？**  
训练只在有限样本和有限损失下改变参数，使模型趋向零；它没有改变函数空间。只要模型的表示允许中心对称输入映射到非零的 \(V^{G^+}\) 分量，优化器就可能找到小但非零的解。O(3) 模型则在函数空间层面排除了这些解，因此零值与参数、训练集和损失无关。

**为什么 \(m\bar3m\) 晶体是 SO(3) 模型的控制组？**  
该类晶体的 proper-rotation 子群是 432。对于三阶压电张量，432 的不变子空间本身已经为零，所以：

\[
\dim V^{G^+}=0,\qquad \gamma_3=0
\]

SO(3) 与 O(3) 在此类晶体上都必须输出零。若某模型仍在该类上产生显著响应，则问题来自近似等变性、数值误差、结构识别错误或实现缺陷，而不是缺少宇称这一单一因素。

**为什么测试时反演平均会“人为得到零”？**  
对精确满足 A1、A2 的 SO(3) 模型，反演后的周期结构只是重标记和平移，因此两次前向计算相同：

\[
f(x)=f(Ix)
\]

对奇宇称采用差分后：

\[
[f(x)-f(Ix)]/2=0
\]

这并不是模型学会了反演，也没有保证对任意输入和任意目标都正确；它是利用结构身份把输出直接抵消。近似等变的 EqV2 不满足这个身份，因此该技巧失效。

# 第五部分：创新评估与关联

## 创新性判断

**把“宇称是否显式编码”从实现细节提升为物理可靠性判据。**  
过去 2–5 年的等变材料模型工作通常重点讨论旋转等变性、角动量截断、表达能力、计算效率和预测精度。给定材料进一步指出，模型即使旋转等变，也可能在晶体对称性严格禁止的物性上输出非零值。新颖性不在于再次提出“使用对称性”，而在于明确区分：

\[
\text{近似变换正确性}
\quad\neq\quad
\text{物理禁戒量严格为零}
\]

**提出可在训练前计算的 parity gap。**  
相比依赖数据、模型或训练后评估的经验指标，\(\gamma_r(G)\) 仅由目标张量表示和晶体点群决定。它能够提前回答：

1. 目标是否具有奇宇称；
2. proper rotations 是否已经足以强制零；
3. 缺少宇称会暴露多少个非零自由度；
4. 哪些晶体类别最适合进行无标签物理验证。

这是从“模型训练后观察异常”推进到“建模前预测风险”。

**采用匹配架构消融，直接隔离单一设计变量。**  
NequIP、Allegro 和 MACE 两组模型共享数据、超参数、架构主体、划分和随机种子，仅改变宇称标签。SO(3) 组参数量还多 0.2%–39.8%，排除了模型容量差异造成的解释。这样的设计比单纯比较不同现成模型更能支持因果判断。

**证明普通训练策略无法替代结构性约束。**  
显式零标签、1,000 个零样本、250–16,000 个零样本注入、100 倍损失权重以及测试时反演平均都被逐一检验。尤其是样本从 250 增至 16,000 后，中位数只下降 8.6 倍而 false-flag 仍为 0.858，说明“学得更接近零”和“架构保证恒等为零”之间存在本质差异。

**将问题延伸到冻结通用势和真实部署链路。**  
以往架构对称性分析常集中于从头训练的模型。这里进一步说明：属性头无法弥补冻结骨干中已经丢失的宇称结构。MACE-MP-0 与 eSEN-30M-OAM 的对比把这一点直接连接到当前材料基础模型的使用方式。

**给出可操作的秒级验证方法。**  
通过随机初始化下的一次反射测试，即可判断模型是 \(O(3)\)-等变、仅 \(SO(3)\)-等变，还是存在近似实现误差。这一验证不需要训练数据，也不需要物性标签，适合纳入模型发布前的验证门、模型卡和材料基准套件。

**前人未解决的问题及其解决程度。**  
根据给定文本，前人已经涉及：

- 旋转等变网络；
- 缺少宇称导致手性表达失败；
- 在输出头显式施加张量约束；
- 有意放宽等变性以处理对称性破缺；
- 冻结通用势上训练属性头。

尚未被充分解决的问题是：**内部表示是否能对严格由晶体对称性强制为零的物性提供参数无关保证，以及缺失该保证在实际材料预测中会造成多大代价。** 该研究用压电张量、2,000 个中心对称晶体、90–96% false flags、六数量级差距和冻结骨干实验回答了这一问题。

**总体评价。**  
创新性主要属于“概念澄清 + 群论判据 + 严格匹配实验 + 部署审计”的组合创新。它没有提出新的通用神经网络层或新的训练算法，但改变了对材料等变模型的评估标准：除了精度和旋转等变误差，还必须报告**实际特征对称性群**，并检查模型是否能够将对称性禁止的输出从函数空间中彻底排除。

elements.研究问题: 材料机器学习模型在中心对称晶体上，为什么会对按群论严格禁止的物性给出非零预测？核心要问的是：只做旋转等变是否足够，还是必须显式编码宇称，才能把“物理上不可能的响应”从模型函数空间里彻底排除。
elements.创新方法: 提出“宇称缺口”这一群论判据，用晶体点群的 proper 旋转子群与完整点群之间的维数差，提前判断哪些目标张量会暴露于缺失宇称的风险；再对 NequIP、Allegro、MACE 做成对消融，只改一个设计位：特征是否携带宇称标签，用 O(3) 与 SO(3) 的对照直接验证结构性零值是否能被架构保证。
elements.工作流程: 输入中心对称晶体结构与目标张量任务，先用群论计算宇称缺口，筛出应为严格零的物性；再分别送入带宇称标签的 O(3) 等变模型和仅 SO(3) 等变模型；最后比较输出是否出现超过阈值的非零响应，并在零标签注入、反演平均、冻结骨干读出等设置下检验这种零值保证能否被训练或后处理恢复。
elements.关键结果: 在 2,000 个经验证的中心对称绝缘晶体上，O(3) 模型对三阶压电张量没有一次超过 0.01 C m^-2，误差压到浮点精度；SO(3) 模型却在 90%–96% 晶体上产生物理不可能的非零响应，中位数差距约 10^6 倍。加入大量零标签、提高损失权重或做测试时反演平均，都只能缩小数值，不能恢复结构性精确零。
elements.应用价值: 这项研究把宇称从实现细节提升为材料基础模型的可靠性门槛，能直接指导模型选型、基准评测和发布审计。它特别适合需要严格零约束的奇秩极性张量预测，也能反过来检查数据对称性标注是否错误，避免把物理上不可能的输出带进实际材料发现流程。

title: Bernstein-Vazirani Networks: Quantum Machine Learning by Interference
title_zh: 文献研究：Bernstein-Vazirani Networks: Quantum Machine Learning by Interference
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.19043v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Bernstein-Vazirani Networks (BVNs), a non-variational quantum machine learning framework that leverages quantum interference for supervised learning, demonstrated on vision and representation learning tasks. In their standard form, BVNs follow the principle of quantum Fourier sampling: labelled data are placed in superposition and interfered in the Fourier basis to extract globally informative features. We then define generalised BVNs that enable interference in problem-adapted bases, yielding more expressive models under the same measurement budget as in the standard setting. BVNs achieve universal function approximation through (over)complete interference bases, while training of BVNs is gradient-free. Experiments on synthetic and real-world classification tasks, as well as implicit image representation, show strong generalisation capabilities and competitive performance with classical and quantum baselines.

title: How Quantum Is the Advantage? A Fair, Calibration- and Noise-Aware Benchmark and Attribution Audit of Quantum Machine Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
title_zh: 文献研究：How Quantum Is the Advantage? A Fair, Calibration- and Noise-Aware Benchmark and Attribution Audit of Quantum Machine Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) for network intrusion detection (NIDS) is routinely reported to reach near-perfect accuracy, yet the most rigorous studies find that well-tuned classical models remain competitive, and that apparent quantum gains may be artefacts of classical dimensionality reduction and implicit regularisation rather than genuine quantum effects. We ask not whether a quantum model can post a high accuracy, but how quantum the advantage really is. We present a unified, reproducible QML-IDS benchmark evaluating hybrid variational quantum circuits and quantum-kernel SVMs against five honestly-tuned classical baselines across four standard NIDS datasets (NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, CICIDS2017, NF-ToN-IoT-v2) under one leakage-controlled protocol, with an equal-budget feature view, imbalance- and calibration-aware metrics with significance testing, and a simulated NISQ noise sweep. We introduce a quantum-attribution audit (parameter-matched classical controls, a random-feature kernel, and a regularisation sweep) that quantifies how much of any gain is genuinely attributable to the quantum component. Tuned classical models (Random Forest, XGBoost) match or exceed the quantum models on aggregate detection on every dataset, and the audit attributes this to classical preprocessing and regularisation rather than quantum effects. Two advantages survive false-discovery-rate correction: the quantum-kernel SVM out-ranks its direct classical surrogate (a random-feature kernel) on AUPRC and ROC-AUC, and a small four-qubit hybrid out-detects the best classical baseline at the 1% false-positive operating point on the distribution-shifted NSL-KDD task (p = 0.005, BH q = 0.030). Code, seeds, and splits are released; our contribution stands whether quantum wins, ties, or loses.

title: Deep Learning-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Surface Finish and Tool Wear in CNC Dry Turning
title_zh: 深度学习驱动的数控干式车削表面质量与刀具磨损多目标优化
summary: 研究构建并实验验证了一个面向中碳钢数控干式车削的深度学习多目标优化框架，以协调表面粗糙度与刀具寿命之间的权衡。深度神经网络代理模型优于传统幂律模型，并结合 NSGA-III、TOPSIS 和膝点识别生成可操作的参数建议。其表面粗糙度和刀具磨损模型的交叉验证误差分别降至 7.65% 和 1.01%。
abstract: Achieving fine surface finish without sacrificing tool life is the defining trade-off of computer numerical control (CNC) turning, yet parameter selection on production-grade lathes still relies largely on conservative handbook values. This paper develops a fully data-driven, deep-learning-enabled multi-objective optimization framework for dry turning of medium-carbon steel and validates it experimentally on a production CNC lathe. A three-factor, three-level full factorial experiment spanning the practical operating envelope of spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut provides the training dataset. Analysis of variance establishes that surface roughness and tool wear are governed by different, partly conflicting subsets of the cutting parameters, confirming a genuine two-objective conflict. Deep neural network regression surrogates are trained for both responses and benchmarked against classical power-law models under leave-one-out cross-validation; the superior surrogates are then embedded in the reference-point-based evolutionary algorithm NSGA-III to trace the Pareto front, and TOPSIS ranking with knee-point identification and weight-sensitivity analysis converts the front into operatorready recommendations in which feed rate and depth of cut collapse to single robust values, leaving spindle speed as the sole trade-off dial. Quantitatively, the deep networks reduce the cross-validated mean absolute percentage error of the roughness model from 9.79% to 7.65% and of the wear model from 6.68% to 1.01%; the predicted Pareto front extends 28% deeper into the fine-finish region than the power-law front, exposing an experimentally observed optimum that the parametric model overestimates by 40% and would therefore misprice; and the knee-point compromise recommendation is complemented by a TOPSIS ranking that is robust for all roughness weightings up to 55%.

title: Predictingthe Trainability of Variational Quantum Circuits: A Data-Driven Model for BarrenPlateaus
title_zh: 预测变分量子电路的可训练性：一种用于识别贫瘠高原的数据驱动模型
summary: 研究探讨能否仅根据量子电路架构预测其可训练性，以减少直接采样大量梯度的成本。作者利用精确态矢量模拟器生成随机变分电路数据集，以梯度方差作为标签，并使用梯度提升模型预测可训练性及区分贫瘠高原电路。文中用于报告部分数据集规模和性能指标的占位符尚未被具体数值替换，但研究指出可观测量局域性与纠缠结构最为关键。
abstract: Barren plateaus are the main obstacle to training quantum machine-learning models. On a barren plateau, the cost-function gradient shrinks exponentially as the circuit grows, and training stalls. Today the only reliable test is to measure it. That means sampling many gradients for every candidate circuit, which is expensive. We ask a different question. Can a classical model predict trainability from the circuit architecture alone? The architecture here means qubit count, depth, ansatz type, entanglement pattern, entangler gate, and cost-observable locality. We test this directly. We use an exact statevector simulator to build a dataset of Nrows{} random variational circuits. For each circuit we estimate the gradient variance Var[partial C/partialθ] from Samples{} random parameter vectors, using the parameter-shift rule. This variance is the label. A gradient-boosted regressor then predicts łog₁₀Var with R² = RsqHold{} on held-out architectures. A classifier separates barren from trainable circuits with an area under the ROC curve of AucHold{}. We also test transfer to larger circuits. We train only on small circuits and test on the two largest unseen sizes (n=11,12). The model still reaches R² = RsqExtrap{}. Permutation importance then recovers established theory. Cost-observable locality and entanglement structure matter most. We make no quantum-advantage claim. This is classical machine learning about quantum circuits. It offers a cheap way to screen ansätze, and it shows which design choices cause untrainability.

title: Toward Efficient and Accurate EMRI Parameter Estimation: A Machine Learning-Enhanced MCMC Framework
title_zh: 迈向高效且准确的EMRI参数估计：机器学习增强的MCMC框架
summary: 极端质量比旋近系统（EMRI）的引力波探测有望深化对强场引力和黑洞物理的认识，但其高度退化且非凸的似然空间给传统MCMC方法带来巨大挑战。本文提出流匹配MCMC（FM-MCMC），将连续归一化流与并行退火MCMC结合，用于生成高似然区域并进行精细探索。该方法在现���仪器噪声和宽先验下实现数量级的计算效率提升，同时保持统计无偏，有望支持空间引力波观测中的实时精确参数推断。
abstract: arXiv:2508.00348v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The detection of gravitational waves from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) in space-based antennas like Taiji and Laser Interferometer Space Antenna promises deep insights into strong-field gravity and black hole physics. However, the complex, highly degenerate, and nonconvex likelihood landscapes characteristic of EMRI parameter spaces pose severe challenges for conventional Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. Under realistic instrumental noise and broad priors, these methods demand impractical computational costs but are prone to becoming trapped in local maxima, leading to biased and unreliable parameter estimates. To address these challenges, we introduce flow-matching MCMC (FM-MCMC), a novel Bayesian framework that integrates continuous normalizing flows (CNFs) with parallel tempering MCMC (PTMCMC). By generating high-likelihood regions via CNFs and refining them through PTMCMC, FM-MCMC enables robust exploration of the nontrivial parameter spaces, achieves orders-of-magnitude improvement in computational efficiency, and, more importantly, ensures statistically unbiased inference. By enabling real-time, unbiased parameter inference, FM-MCMC could unlock the full scientific potential of EMRI observations, and would serve as a scalable pipeline for precision gravitational-wave astronomy.

title: Physics-Informed and Hybrid Machine Learning in Additive Manufacturing: Application to Fused Filament Fabrication
title_zh: 增材制造中的物理信息与混合机器学习：熔融挤出成型的应用
summary: 本文研究了多种物理信息和混合机器学习策略，用于结合实验数据和物理知识，预测熔融挤出成型部件的结合质量与孔隙率。研究比较了在损失函数中加入物理约束、将多物理场模拟输出作为额外输入，以及利用物理模型预训练后再用实验数据更新三类策略。结果表明，多种策略的组合能够在实验数据有限时构建准确且符合物理规律的机器学习模型。
abstract: arXiv:2608.17246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article investigates several physics-informed and hybrid machine learning strategies that incorporate physics knowledge in experimental data-driven deep-learning models for predicting the bond quality and porosity of fused filament fabrication (FFF) parts. Three types of strategies are explored to incorporate physics constraints and multi-physics FFF simulation results into a deep neural network (DNN), thus ensuring consistency with physical laws: (1) incorporate physics constraints within the loss function of the DNN, (2) use physics model outputs as additional inputs to the DNN model, and (3) pre-train a DNN model with physics model input-output and then update it with experimental data. These strategies help to enforce a physically consistent relationship between bond quality and tensile strength, thus making porosity predictions physically meaningful. Eight different combinations of the above strategies are investigated. The results show how the combination of multiple strategies produces accurate machine learning models even with limited experimental data.

title: Physics-informed neural network for inverse modeling of granular flows
title_zh: 文献研究：Physics-informed neural network for inverse modeling of granular flows
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Granular flows are ubiquitous in natural and industrial systems, yet their complex dynamics remain difficult to characterize. For inverse problems involving unknown inlet, outlet, and wall boundary conditions, where CFD simulations are challenging, reconstructing complete flow fields from sparse observations constitutes a challenging inverse problem. In this study, a physics-informed neural network framework driven by both physical mechanisms and measurement data is developed to reconstruct the steady-state full-field distribution of granular flows in a pipe. The proposed approach integrates sparse measurement data with governing equations and constitutive relations and is trained using high-fidelity datasets generated by CFD solutions of a continuum model. The framework incorporates a dimensionless loss formulation, physics-informed initialization, dynamic global weighting, and a locally weighted granular temperature data-loss strategy. These treatments enable accurate reconstruction of the complete flow-field evolution. This work establishes a robust methodological framework for flow-field reconstruction in complex granular flow systems.

title: Néel-order-dependent transverse transport in noncoplanar antiferromagnet MnTe₂
title_zh: 文献研究：Néel-order-dependent transverse transport in noncoplanar antiferromagnet MnTe₂
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets hold appealing potential in next-generation spintronic devices with higher frequency and scalability, thanks to their alternating spin orientations that cancel out net magnetization. However, the lack of a nonzero magnetization makes the detection of the magnetic configuration of antiferromagnet difficult, hampering the applications of antiferromagnets. Here, we report a new transverse transport effect in noncoplanar antiferromagnet MnTe₂. This effect is antisymmetric in both magnetic field and Néel order, but symmetric in its two indices. It can be understood in terms of the contribution induced by both magnetic field and geometric quantities, as confirmed by our theoretical calculations. Our discovery of a new Néel-order-dependent transverse transport effect provides opportunities to the advancing antiferromagnetic spintronics.

title: Room-temperature ferroelectrically switchable quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2 for complementary in-memory computing
title_zh: 文献研究：Room-temperature ferroelectrically switchable quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2 for complementary in-memory computing
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry, describing the inherent geometric structure of electron wavefunctions in momentum space, transcends the traditional charge degree of freedom and provides a novel physical basis for information encoding and processing. The key to such new computing paradigms is the non-volatile electrical programming of quantum geometric states at room temperature, which, however, has not been established. Here, we demonstrate ferroelectrically switchable quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2, which uniquely enables complementary convolutional processing. By employing the intrinsic coupling between ferroelectric polarization and quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2, we show that the second- and third-order nonlinear anomalous Hall effects (NLAHE) can be deterministically and electrically switched in a nonvolatile and correlated manner. The switching is robust at room temperature for ~104 cycles and retention of ~105 s. Furthermore, leveraging the opposite switching behaviors of second- and third-order NLAHE at room temperature, we demonstrate complementary in-memory computing and implement a hardware-level complementary convolution kernel. This kernel overcomes the inherent directional specificity of conventional convolutional networks and achieves a texture recognition accuracy of 98%, thereby illustrating a viable pathway towards physics-native computing through exploiting exotic physics in quantum materials.

title: Localized Excitons and Exciton-Phonon Coupling in Antiferromagnetic AgCrP2S6
title_zh: 反铁磁AgCrP₂S₆中的局域激子与激子-声子耦合
summary: AgCrP₂S₆具有低对称性硫代磷酸盐骨架、反铁磁Cr子晶格和非磁性Ag位点，为研究共价性与磁局域性在低能光学响应中的竞争提供了平台。作者结合单晶X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、晶格动力学计算以及带有自洽顶角修正的费曼图多体方法，研究了其结构、电子和激子性质。计算表明，约1.4 eV的低能激发簇主要是局域的、强各向异性的Frenkel激子，具有以局域d-d跃迁为主并伴随显著配体辅助d-p混合的特征。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AgCrP2S6 combines a low-symmetry thiophosphate framework with an antiferromagnetic Cr sublattice and nonmagnetic Ag sites, providing a setting in which covalency and magnetic localization compete in the low-energy optical response. We combine single-crystal x-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, lattice-dynamical calculations, and self-consistent vertex corrected Feynman diagrammatic many-body approaches to determine the structural, electronic, and excitonic properties of bulk AgCrP2S6. The material remains monoclinic between 100 and 300 K, with additional Ag-site disorder resolved at low temperature, and the optimized structure is dynamically stable. The many-body calculations yield a reduced quasiparticle gap relative to Cr trihalides, but the lowest excitons remain predominantly local: the calculated low-energy (~1.4 eV) excitation cluster is best described as a weakly bright, strongly anisotropic Frenkel exciton with dominant onsite d-d character and substantial ligand-assisted d-p admixture. Symmetry analysis in the C2h setting identifies this state as predominantly Bu and constrains its leading exciton-phonon coupling channels to Ag diagonal renormalization and Bg-mediated bright-dark mixing. These results place AgCrP2S6 in a localized excitonic regime in which the stronger p-d hybridization, relative to the more ionic Cr trihalides, narrows the quasiparticle gap, while the antiferromagnetic exchange and Ag-site dilution disfavor the intersite coherence associated with strongly delocalized low-energy excitons.

title: Optical poling of a quantum ferroelectric metal across the order-disorder phase transition
title_zh: 文献研究：Optical poling of a quantum ferroelectric metal across the order-disorder phase transition
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-doped strontium titanate has emerged as a prototypical quantum ferroelectric metal. It provides a fertile ground to explore how ferroelectric instability intertwined with itinerant electrons creates quantum phenomena, including unconventional superconductivity. Despite extensive studies, the microscopic origin of the ferroelectric transition remains unsettled, with distinct interpretations based on displacive mechanism driven by soft mode and order-disorder alignment of local dipoles. In particular, the local dipoles form nanoscale, spatially heterogeneous clusters, termed polar nanoregions, posing a significant challenge for probing or manipulating them. Here, using rotational anisotropy second harmonic generation, a symmetry-resolved probe, we quantify the orientational statistics of polar nanoregions in dilute electron-doped Sr₀.₉₅Ba₀.₀₅Ti₁₋ₓNbₓO₃. By tracking the alignment and meltdown of polar nanoregions in thermal cycles, we unambiguously demonstrate the order-disorder nature of the ferroelectric transition. We further show that, above transition temperature, femtosecond optical fields enable deterministic control of otherwise disordered polar nanoregions, realizing reversible write and readout of polar textures on ultrafast timescales. Our findings provide new insight into ferroelectric instability and establish an all-optical route of controlling polar metal systems where conventional electrical approaches are not feasible.

title: Breaking the mutual exclusivity between metallicity and ferroelectricity in a non-polar covalent semiconductor via orbital selective doping
title_zh: 通过轨道选择性掺杂打破非极性共价半导体中金属性与铁电性的相互排斥
summary: 由于巡游电子会屏蔽稳定体相极性有序所需的长程库仑力，铁电性与金属导电性通常被认为相互排斥。作者通过氮重掺杂立方碳化硅，使材料由非极性F-43m结构转变为极性R3m结构，并实现了金属性与铁电性的共存。研究还在原子尺度直接观察到约180°的极化反转，并展示了具有非易失存储特性的铁电隧道结。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mutual exclusion of ferroelectricity and metallic conductivity is a long-standing tenet because itinerant electrons screen long-range Coulomb forces that stabilize the bulk polar order. Here, we break this paradigm by heavily doping a non-polar covalent semiconductor of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC) with nitrogen. This introduces heavy electron doping, inducing metallicity and driving a structural transition from the non-polar F-43m to the polar R3m symmetry via the pseudo-Jahn-Teller effect. Remarkably, we provide direct, atomic-scale visualization of about 180deg polarization reversal under an external voltage bias in a ferroelectric metal. The strongly directional character of antibonding orbitals occupied by conduction electrons prevents them from screening the local Si-C polarization, resulting in the coexistence of metallicity and ferroelectricity. Ferroelectric tunnel junctions demonstrate nonvolatile memory properties with a well-defined high-resistance state (HRS) and low-resistance state (LRS), an ultrahigh response speed (~50 ns), an ultralow operating voltage (1 V), an endurance exceeding 85927 cycles, and a projected retention time of 100 years. Our results provide a novel strategy for pioneering ferroelectricity in a metal, a new ferroelectric metal platform for exploring exotic properties, and a ferroelectric device with high performance that meets the requirements for low consumption and high-speed non-volatile devices.

title: Rare-earth spin textures and a route to electronic inhomogeneity in Pr₂Ir₂O₇
title_zh: Pr₂Ir₂O₇中的稀土自旋织构与电子不均匀性的形成途径
summary: Pr₂Ir₂O₇在低温下仍保持金属性，而其同族材料则表现为绝缘体。作者通过蒙特卡洛采样的镨自旋冰构型，并将其与铱电子的八带Hartree-Fock模型通过局域Kondo交换耦合，研究受挫自旋织构是否能够诱发电子不均匀性。结果表明，空间调制的费米能级态密度可通过Kondo温度对Doniach机制的指数敏感性，使局域区域在Kondo屏蔽与磁有序之间发生转变，从而为实验观察到的非均匀性提供受挫驱动的解释。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pyrochlore iridate Pr₂Ir₂O₇ remains metallic at low temperatures where its family members insulate. Recently, scanning tunneling spectroscopy experiments have revealed an inhomogeneous mixture of Kondo-screened and Kondo-destroyed regions when its surface is produced by cleaving at room temperature while it remains uniform when cleaved at low temperatures. We ask whether the frustrated praseodymium spin texture seeds this inhomogeneity. To study this, we produce Monte-Carlo-sampled Pr spin-ice configurations, presumed to evolve slowly in time, and couple through a local Kondo exchange J_K to an eight-band Hartree-Fock model of the Ir electrons. We further find the charge gap of the all-in-all-out state common in the other family members closes smoothly with the coupling J_K, and the recently proposed monopole-rich ``jellyfish'' textures further suppress the insulating behavior by Δ JKcapprox 0.03,t. Additionally, scanning a small cluster across a large Pr surface yields a synthetic tunneling map that fractures into islands within a sea. Although our classical simulable theory omits the Kondo singlet, the spatial modulation of the Fermi-level density of states it produces is, through the exponential Doniach sensitivity of the Kondo temperature, sufficient to tip the local balance between screening and magnetic order; a frustration-driven route to the observed Kondo/Kondo-destroyed inhomogeneity.

title: Solidification-cell confinement of domain-wall pinning in additively manufactured ferromagnets
title_zh: 增材制造铁磁体中凝固胞限域对畴壁钉扎的作用
summary: 与优化的变形加工材料相比，按成形状态制备的打印铁磁体通常具有更高的矫顽力，但现有解释主要依赖经验拟合或高成本模拟。作者提出一种解析理论，将打印参数直接联系到冷却速率、胞状结构间距、位错密度和畴壁钉扎矫顽力，并利用一个拟合常数对纯铁、Fe-6.9Si及多组分合金的六组实验数据进行预测，结果误差不超过1.9倍。研究还引入限域因子E=√(λc/2δw)，说明凝固诱导的位错聚集会使胞状微结构比传统冷加工金属更难磁化，并可用于制造前的合金成分筛选与排序。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As-built printed ferromagnets typically exhibit higher coercivity than optimized wrought materials, yet existing explanations rely on empirical fits or costly simulations. Herein, we provide a missing analytical theory that links print parameters directly to cooling rates, cellular spacing, dislocation density, and domain-wall pinning coercivity. Informed by metallographic grain data and using a single fitted constant, our model predicts six experimental datasets for pure Fe, Fe-6.9Si, and a multicomponent alloy within a factor of 1.9. We demonstrate that configurational lattice distortion is negligible, implying that single-phase printed alloys follow dilute-pinning laws. Critically, we introduce a confinement factor, E=sqrtłambdac/2δw, proving that solidification-induced dislocation packing makes cellular microstructures harder than conventionally cold-worked metals. The framework enables an alloy-sensitivity map to screen and rank compositions before manufacturing.

title: Interface-Controlled Spin-Orbit Torques in Rare-Earth Synthetic Ferrimagnets Probed by Sagnac Magneto-Optics and Harmonic Hall Measurements
title_zh: 稀土合成亚铁磁体中界面控制的自旋轨道力矩：基于Sagnac磁光学与谐波霍尔测量的研究
summary: 本文结合磁输运和磁光学技术，研究了Co/Gd基合成亚铁磁体中的自旋轨道力矩。Sagnac磁光学干涉法能够直接测量电流诱导的磁化倾斜，并提取类阻尼自旋轨道力矩有效场，其结果与谐波霍尔分析吻合良好。通过改变Gd厚度和多层膜堆叠顺序，作者证明稀土层与重金属界面处的自旋输运和角动量转换显著影响力矩，并在Gd/Pt/Co/Al异质结构中实现了垂直磁各向异性及电流诱导开关。
abstract: arXiv:2608.18370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) provides an efficient route for manipulating magnetization in spintronic devices, and its accurate quantification is essential. Here, we investigate Co/Gd-based synthetic ferrimagnets using complementary magnetotransport and magneto-optical techniques. We use a Sagnac magneto-optical interferometry method to directly quantify current-induced magnetization tilting and extract the damping-like SOT effective field. The Sagnac measurements show good agreement with harmonic Hall analysis across different Co/Gd and Gd/Pt/Co heterostructures, providing a quantitative determination of the damping-like SOT effective field that does not rely on electrical transport signatures. By varying the Gd thickness and multilayer stacking order, we demonstrate that the damping-like torque is strongly influenced by spin transport and angular momentum conversion at rare-earth and heavy-metal interfaces. The observation of a finite torque in Gd/Pt/Co/Pt structures, where conventional Pt spin Hall contributions are expected to compensate, highlights the active role of the Gd layer in SOT generation. Furthermore, interface engineering enables perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in Gd/Pt/Co/Al heterostructures with a 2-nm-thick Co layer, allowing current-induced SOT switching at current densities of 8-10 MA/cm². These results establish rare-earth-based synthetic ferrimagnets as a versatile platform for engineering spin-orbit phenomena and optimizing low-power spintronic devices.

title: Quantum sensing magnonic number states using a bosonic mode as the probe
title_zh: 利用玻色模作为探针对磁振子数态进行量子传感
summary: 此前，人们借助超导量子比特与磁振子模之间的有效色散相互作用，实现了对磁振子模数态的探测。本文从理论上证明，看似经典的玻色模也可作为探针分辨磁振子数态，并在若干方面优于量子比特传感器。作者分别考虑以反铁磁体中的另一磁振子模和声子为探针，推导了由反铁磁交换相互作用或低阶非线性磁振子-声子相互作用产生的有效色散耦合，并提出了识别和利用玻色探针的一般设计原则。
abstract: arXiv:2507.19066v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sensing number states of a magnonic mode has been accomplished using a superconducting qubit by realizing an effective dispersive interaction between the two systems. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that a seemingly classical bosonic mode can be utilized as a probe for resolving the number states of a magnon mode, while outperforming a qubit in various regards as the sensor. Considering another magnon mode in an antiferromagnet as the probe mode, we delineate the required dispersive coupling emerging directly from antiferromagnetic exchange interaction. When a phonon is used as the probe mode, we derive the effective dispersive coupling emerging from the lowest-order nonlinear magnon-phonon interactions. Our two considered examples provide the general design principles for identifying and utilizing a bosonic probe mode for sensing magnonic superpositions in a physical platform of interest.

title: Anti-spin Laue groups: classification of anti-altermagnets and their representative minimal models
title_zh: 文献研究：Anti-spin Laue groups: classification of anti-altermagnets and their representative minimal models
summary: 摘要信息不足，需查阅原文确认具体方法与结论。
abstract: arXiv:2608.19056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anti-altermagnets exhibit odd-parity nonrelativistic spin splitting, yet unlike even-parity altermagnets, their momentum-space symmetries lack a reduced classification analogous to spin Laue groups. Here, we introduce anti-spin Laue groups, organized into three distinct classes, and identify 21 groups describing the odd-parity partial wave character of this unconventional class. Together with the 10 spin Laue groups of altermagnets, they complete the classification of nonrelativistic unconventional magnets with collinear momentum-space spin polarization. Anti-spin Laue groups also provide a many-to-one reduction of spin space (point) groups by retaining only their action on the collinear momentum-space spin polarization, thereby directly encoding the symmetry-enforced nodal spin-splitting character. Based on this we develop a systematic model-construction algorithm yielding minimal, material-oriented four-band models. This framework places odd- and even-parity unconventional magnets on equal footing within a unified momentum-space symmetry description.

title: A Correlated Route to Antiferromagnetic Spintronics
title_zh: 通向反铁磁自旋电子学的关联驱动路径
summary: 反铁磁体具有零净磁化和超快自旋动力学，因而对自旋电子学很有吸引力，但其自旋补偿电子结构长期限制了其作为主动器件的作用。本文提出一个对称性选择定则：在共线反铁磁体中，自旋极化直流电荷电流需要粒子-空穴对称性与两个磁性子晶格等价性的同时破缺，单独破缺任一对称性都不会产生极化。基于动力学平均场理论，作者在掺杂反铁磁哈伯德模型中证明，电子关联可将自旋依赖散射率的层级转化为可由磁场调控的显著电流极化；在关联交错磁哈伯德模型中，同一选择定则由结构性子晶格交替跃迁实现。
abstract: arXiv:2603.16552v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnets are attractive for spintronics owing to their vanishing net magnetization and ultrafast spin dynamics, yet their spin-compensated electronic structure has long confined them to passive roles. Here we identify a symmetry selection rule that overcomes this limitation: in a collinear antiferromagnet, a spin-polarized dc charge current requires the simultaneous breaking of particle--hole symmetry and of the equivalence between the two magnetic sublattices, either one alone leaving the polarization identically zero. We demonstrate the rule in the doped antiferromagnetic Hubbard model within dynamical mean-field theory: doping and a uniform magnetic field each break one of the two symmetries, and electronic correlations convert the resulting hierarchy of spin-dependent scattering rates into a sizable, field-tunable polarization of the charge current. The polarization is largest deep in the ordered phase and reverses sign at an emergent compensation point, not dictated by symmetry, at which the dominant conducting spin species is interchanged. In correlated altermagnetic Hubbard models, the same two symmetries are broken structurally, by the sublattice-alternating hopping pattern: the field-driven mechanism identified here and the altermagnetic one are two realizations of a single selection rule. Electronic correlations thus emerge as an active ingredient for spintronics in structurally conventional collinear antiferromagnets.
